reviews.text: The lady in the blue shirt is very helpful, especially for someone like me who doesn't do a lot of weed. I was hoping they had some cbd stuff but they only have the oil. So I thought while in Rome I gotta try something and have been wanting to try gummies for a while. The brand they sell are the Zaza Asia kind. I got the Watermelon, and boy are they stronnnggg. I followed her instructions and the packet instructions to just have the smallest bit and I was tripping for hours, and for me personally wasn't a positive trip but I am pretty familiar with psychedelics so it didn't freak me out, knew I just had to wait it out. Some of it was pretty cool, except that I wasn't expecting to go tripping so it was a bit annoying having to stay up late lol. So I really don't know how anyone could handle more, I guess if you have a super high tolerance. Either way, this is a good shop and the lady knows her stuff. Highly recommend.

reviews.text_en: We visited about 15 shops in a month, in the Kata, Karon, Kata Noi, and one in Chalong. This is the only shop I returned to for the 16th and 17th time. The stuff is fantastic. For those who want to compare it to what they sell at home, go for 30 THB. You'll immediately feel the difference. The prices are very reasonable!! 600 baht for 25+ THC is a shock. For those who prefer it lighter, there are lighter options for 180 baht mixed with tobacco. Overall, draw your own conclusions, but I give it 5*.
